arguments.sql:
SELECT s.City
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.CDSCode = '01611920113902'
  AND s.County = 'Alameda'
  AND s.EILCode = 'HS'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2'
  AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12';
